transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Well, I came in because... honestly, it's about my husband’s sister. She’s been working this family business, and she is doing it just so she can get control of the money and push me right out of all the decisions. 

Other folks keep trying to smooth it over, but... I know what I’ve been seeing. It's been going on for more than a year now, and I just needed to come in and talk to somebody about it.
Have you noticed that other people don’t share your belief about your husband’s sister, or have they tried to reassure you that this isn’t happening?

Yes, they do. Like I was just saying, folks try to smooth it over. My husband and the rest of them, they tell me I'm just reading too much into it and that she's only trying to help out. They try to reassure me all the time. 

But... well, they just don't see what I see. I know what I’ve been watching her do for over a year now. They can say whatever they want to make it sound better, but it doesn't change the fact that she's setting things up to get control of that money and push me right out of the picture.
Are there other situations or people in your life where you feel others are trying to deceive you or take advantage of you in a similar way?

No, not really. It's just her. I mean, I don't have problems with anyone else trying to trick me or take advantage of me. It's just this one situation with my husband's sister and the business. Everyone else in my life... well, things are just normal with them. It's only her that I have to watch out for.
Have you ever had experiences where you felt like someone was putting thoughts into your mind, or that you were being followed or spied on in some way?

No, I... I've never felt anything like that. Nobody's putting thoughts in my head, and I'm not being followed or spied on or anything crazy like that. It's just what I told you—it's just her, trying to get her hands on the money. I'm just seeing what's right in front of me, that's all.

latest_inference.note: The patient denies other delusional themes such as thought insertion, surveillance, or broader paranoid concerns, which rules out F20.0 (schizophrenia), F23.2 (acute polymorphic psychotic disorder), and F25.0 (schizoaffective disorder). The delusional focus remains circumscribed to a single theme (persecution by the husband's sister related to the business), consistent with F22.0 (delusional disorder).
